syllabus_topics: Linear algebra - determinants, matrices, systems of linear equations
Analytical geometry in plane and space – vector calculus, lines and planes in space
Differential calculus – basic theorems, Teylor’s formula, applications (extremums, asymptotes, graphics)
Integral calculus – definition and basic properties of the primitive function, basic methods of integration, integration of rational functions and some classes of irrational functions
Riemann integral - definition, basic methods for calculation
Ordinary differential equations – definition and geometric interpretation
Second order LDE with constant terms
assessment_rules: Students might not solve problems at the exam if their average mark from control tests and home assignments is at least 4.50. Part of the exam material can be tested earlier via oral discussion, but the final exam mark is received at the end of the semester.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
